title: Rat King of the Storm
description: An anthropomorphic rat stands amid turbulent red and black stormy seas, wearing an ornate purple and gold royal robe, a large golden crown, and holding a golden scepter topped with a crown. Lightning cracks across the dark purple sky filled with swirling smoke and flying miniature crowns.
prompt: Anthropomorphic gray rat standing in the center of a violent stormy ocean with crashing red and black waves, wearing a flowing purple royal robe decorated with golden crowns and a long red cape, a large ornate golden crown on its head, holding a golden royal scepter with a small crown on top, dramatic purple and black stormy sky with lightning bolts and swirling orange and purple smoke with tiny floating crowns, highly detailed fantasy painting
